## What's Changed

- Prevent AI findings from contradicting 5xx statuses found in retained evidence samples.
- Support explicit grouped-count requests with metadata-validated filters and fail closed on unsupported conditions.
- Improve AI and integration guidance for evidence safety and grouped-count query behavior.
